events.title: Updates for version 1.0
events.summary: Hello there,This update includes the following:Updated spider to slow down longer after being hit by spirit beads.Fixed the game creating a new save automatically in the first slot when loading save.Updated the mirror effect to be better.Thanks for playing and please let me know if you have any issues.Larry

events.title: Updates for build 0.9.9.20
events.summary: Hello there,This build has the following changes:Removed black bars for certain interactions that aren't necessary.Added smoke detectors to various scenes.Fixed Photo Match text not typewriter printing all the time when matched.Fixed photo match text sometimes not showing up on a loaded game for first photo.Thanks!Larry

events.title: Updates for build 0.9.9.19
events.summary: Hello there,This build contains the following:Tweaked some models and graveyard for performance and visuals in castle exterior.Updated layout of Adult Family Home spirits and masks to fit the story better.Adjusted how the home mirror handles imagery.Fixed photos sometimes not being visible on a new game.Added ghost spirit to the classroom.Updated the speed of throwing and tossing animations.Updated the lighting in the interior castle.Fixed vines that shouldn't glow green.Thanks,Larry

events.title: Updates for 0.9.9.17 (wayfinding and more)

events.title: Updates for 0.9.9.14
events.summary: Hello there,This build addresses the following:Updated how bead, stone, and prayer receivers register hits.Fixed particles for wall with spirit embedded in it.Updated button mapping for gamepads to use right shoulder for attack.Fixed cat mask requirements to unlock.Updated some ghost events to happend in different pass through castle.Moved animal mask to cave tunnel.Fixed look of end particles.Thanks!Larry

events.title: Updates for build 0.9.9.10
events.summary: Hello there,This build addresses the following:Updated player to move a tad bit quicker so it feels less weighty. I'll keep looking into this.Removed crosshair when the camera focuses on an object.Significantly reduced the frequency of the apparition events.Updated the vines to look more like, well, vines.Updated the demo so it's clear how to finish it.Added polaroid photos in each level that have to be found first before matching.Thanks again for playing! Lemme know if there are any issues.Larr
